main_tapeta.bias_notes: An all-weather Tapeta synthetic surface that plays much closer to turf than dirt. Incredibly fair track that heavily penalizes one-dimensional front-runners ('E') while strongly rewarding sustained momentum and late-closing kicks ('Swoopers').
main_tapeta.post_bias: Extremely fair. Outside posts are not penalized in sprint chutes because riders have ample time to find cover. Inside posts (1–4) in routes hold a slight ground-saving edge.

ep_taylor_turf.bias_notes: A world-famous, massive European-style turf course with a grueling 1,440-foot home stretch. It is the ultimate closer's paradise. One-dimensional speed horses almost always collapse in the final 200 yards.
ep_taylor_turf.post_bias: Very fair due to the massive 1.5-mile circumference. Wide sweeping trips are entirely manageable.

inner_turf.bias_notes: A tighter North American-style 7/8-mile turf oval set inside the main Tapeta track. Considerably tighter than the E.P. Taylor course, placing a higher premium on tactical early speed and inside positioning.
inner_turf.post_bias: Inside posts (1–4) hold a distinct advantage here due to tight first turns.

handicapping_angles.dirt_to_synthetic_tax: Traditional dirt specialists (e.g. Parx, Finger Lakes, or Saratoga dirt shippers) with zero synthetic experience face a -3.0 point discount on Tapeta. Conversely, turf horses shipping to Tapeta receive a +3.0 point boost as turf form translates seamlessly to Tapeta.
handicapping_angles.ep_taylor_endless_stretch_penalty: On the massive E.P. Taylor turf course (1,440-foot stretch), apply a -4.0 point penalty to one-dimensional 'Need-the-Lead' ('E') horses in route races (1M to 1 1/2M). Stalkers and closers with proven late pace ratings dominate.
handicapping_angles.inner_turf_tactical_rail_boost: On the 7/8-mile Inner Turf course, grant a +3.0 point bonus to tactical pressers ('P') and early speed ('E') drawn in Posts 1–4 to capitalize on the tighter turns.
handicapping_angles.woodbine_mile_and_kings_plate_class: Top-tier shippers from Saratoga, Belmont, and European Group stakes (e.g. Charlie Appleby / Godolphin shippers) carry an elite class edge in Grade 1/2 stakes events.
